speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Old Swan by two. I am not giving you the middle of it. The ebb was the ebb, and the sun was thin, and we are at the stair.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: The Queen paid you in the boat, there's ice from here to the bridge, and they'll have you again on Twelfth Day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three again, Davy. Twelfth Day I had this morning, from my lord's man, and it is true. There is no ice. I have just come down the river. It was water. The Queen did not pay us in a boat. Two corrections, and I am done.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Two corrections and one kept. I will take a tide like that. Sit was the easy part. You managed it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Sir. What does a queen do, when she is a man?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He learns to stand differently. Thou'st time.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will not sing on the hill to find out. I can walk without it. I said so last night, and it is still true.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then walk without it. A new voice is not a ballad for Fish Street. You are with me. A board of sharers is not your next room.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Before you take him, hear the ear. I want the ass's head by Candlemas. The ears a hand longer than the head. If they are shorter, the gallery thinks it a hat, and a hat is a different joke.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Candlemas is not this stair. You may have the ears when there is a head to sew them to. I am not sewing on a landing.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am not asking you to sew. I am telling you the length while I remember it, and before the hill knocks it out of my head.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The baskets have gone on to Shoreditch in a cart. We are not following the cart. The feet are pointed up the hill. I am not calling a meeting, and I am not naming a house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the hill can have the rest of us. Nick, go with Augustine.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am going. Thank you for the time, sir. I will spend it standing, as you said.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: No humming. Humming is a try. Come.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: The stair is wet. Mind the green weed on it. That one is true, and I give it to you at no charge, since you were hard on my ice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The weed I believe. God keep you, Davy. Westward ho can wait until you are going the other way.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: And you, Master Will. This way is the City, and the City can have you. I am keeping the one you did not correct.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Ears. A hand longer than the head. I will say it once more, and then I will be quiet about animals.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once is enough. A hand longer than the head. I have it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The baskets are the cart's. This morning's ten shillings is not a cart. Leave it in the purse it is already in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My ten is in my purse. It is not paying a cart, and it is not paying a hill.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then the hill is unpaid, which is the right price. Come on, before I invent a second beast out of sheer idleness.

speaker: john_heminges
text: One beast is enough for a landing. The head can wait for a workroom. God keep you, Davy.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Keep the tide. It kept you, whether you give me the middle or not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not giving you the middle of it. The stair was the point. Up the hill.
